name: deeperas
description: Clarify the choices that matter, verify available evidence, and carry confirmed requirements and open prerequisites through work in Codex, Cursor and Claude Code.

interface.shortDescription: One useful question at a time
interface.longDescription: Use Deeperas in Codex, Cursor or Claude Code to turn vague requests into clear, verifiable work. It asks one focused question at a time and rechecks unresolved prerequisites after each reply, investigates facts with the host's files and tools, and carries confirmed requirements and open prerequisites through follow-ups. Clear requests, delegated choices and supported advice can proceed directly. The R72 core uses 65 condition/action rules and six topic references. Optional local project memory is off by default and needs explicit authorization. Your host supplies the model, tools and permissions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Deeperas to clarify the choices that matter before answering.
